title: Famelack: Free Live TV, Radio & Webcams | FreeHub
description: Explore Famelack, formerly TV.Garden, for free live TV, radio and webcams. Read the South African access check, data costs, limits and steps before opening it.
intro: Looking for something to watch or listen to without another subscription? Famelack brings international live TV, radio and webcams into one browser-based directory. Use this guide to decide what to try and what to check first.
accessNote: A FreeHub reviewer reported successful access from a South African internet connection, confirmed to us on 2 November 2026. This was a user-reported access check, not an independent test of every channel, station or webcam. Individual streams can still be restricted or unavailable.
steps: Open Famelack and choose what you want to explore from its homepage.
Choose TV, Radio or Webcam mode. Browse a country or category, or use the globe to explore.
Select a channel, station or camera and start playback. If it is unavailable, try another source; a working directory does not guarantee every feed works.
Check your data balance while streaming. Close playback when finished rather than leaving a stream running in the background.

sections.heading: What can you use Famelack for?
paragraphs: Famelack describes its service as free access to live TV, online radio and live webcams, with no account or subscription. The selection includes international news, music, places and nature. Choose a mode that matches what you want to do: watch a live channel, listen to a station or explore a camera view.

This listing covers an external directory. FreeHub does not play, host or retransmit its streams, and does not sell a television package. You choose and use the content on Famelack and its external sources.

sections.heading: What South African viewers should check
paragraphs: Successful access to Famelack is useful evidence that the site can be reached from South Africa. It does not establish that a particular broadcaster permits viewing here, that every programme is available, or that playback will work on every network and device.

Famelack says some streams have regional restrictions and others may go offline or change address. If a source fails, choose another available source. For a particular broadcaster or programme, check the broadcaster's own viewing information.

sections.heading: Free access still uses your internet connection
paragraphs: A free service can still use paid mobile data or Wi-Fi. Check your bundle and connection costs before a long viewing session. Video quality and viewing time affect data consumption, so we do not quote one hourly data figure for all streams.
On a limited bundle, keep an eye on your device's usage counter and stop playback when you finish. Audio may suit a listening session better than leaving a video playing when you only need the sound.

sections.heading: External sources, privacy and content rights
paragraphs: Famelack says it links to external sources and does not host or restream the underlying content. Its disclaimer also says it cannot guarantee every link's copyright status. FreeHub's listing does not certify the rights or regional availability of individual streams.

External players and stream providers can receive technical information when you connect. Read Famelack's Privacy Policy from its menu before using the service if you want details about those connections.

faq.question: Is Famelack the same service as TV.Garden?
faq.answer: Famelack's official FAQ says TV.Garden was renamed Famelack and expanded to include radio and webcams.

faq.question: Does Famelack work in South Africa?
faq.answer: A FreeHub reviewer reported successful access from South Africa. This is not a guarantee for every stream: regional restrictions, outages and device differences can affect playback.

faq.question: Do I need to register or start a free trial?
faq.answer: Famelack says its browser service does not require an account or subscription. This listing does not involve a FreeHub trial or payment. Normal internet costs still apply.

faq.question: Why does a channel or webcam fail to play?
faq.answer: The external source may be offline, restricted to another region, or unsupported in your browser. Try another source and check the provider's information if you need a specific channel.

title: SAP Learning Hub student edition | FreeHub
description: A renewable 12-month student subscription with SAP learning journeys, practice systems, live sessions and two certification exam attempts. Verify active university enrolment or faculty status with SAP. An SAP Universal ID, university email and an internet-connected device are needed.
intro: SAP offers a free student edition of Learning Hub for eligible university students and faculty. It combines structured SAP learning with practice access and two certification exam attempts during the subscription period.
accessNote: Verify active university enrolment or faculty status with SAP. An SAP Universal ID, university email and an internet-connected device are needed.
steps: Open SAP’s student-edition page and check the academic eligibility rules.
Create or sign in with your SAP Universal ID and complete university verification.
Once approved, choose a learning journey and use the included practice systems.
Prepare for the relevant examination and check the two-attempt allowance before booking.

sections.heading: What the free subscription includes
paragraphs: The student edition lasts 12 months. SAP lists learning journeys, expert-led live sessions, practice systems and two certification exam attempts among its benefits. You can renew if you still meet the academic requirements.
This can be useful for a student exploring enterprise software, analytics or business processes. Choose a learning path relevant to your studies before spending an examination attempt.

sections.heading: Who can use it from South Africa
paragraphs: The academic programme is global and includes eligible South African university users. SAP verifies enrolment or faculty status; access is not a general free subscription for anyone with a personal email address.
Your own internet and device costs remain. The included learning and examination allowance does not guarantee employment or a certification pass.

faq.question: Is the certification examination free?
faq.answer: The student edition includes two SAP certification exam attempts. You must be accepted into the programme and use the attempts under SAP’s current rules.

faq.question: How long does access last?
faq.answer: The subscription lasts 12 months and can be renewed while you remain eligible.

faq.question: Do I need a credit card?

faq.question: Does it include a free AWS certification exam?

title: South African Library for the Blind | FreeHub
description: Free accessible-library membership with audio and Braille reading resources for eligible members. Apply to SALB and have the eligibility section completed or certified by a competent authority. Ask the library which accessible formats and services suit your needs.
intro: The South African Library for the Blind helps eligible readers access books in formats they can use. Its free membership includes accessible reading resources such as audio and Braille materials.
accessNote: Apply to SALB and have the eligibility section completed or certified by a competent authority. Ask the library which accessible formats and services suit your needs.
steps: Read SALB’s enrolment instructions and download the membership form.
Complete your personal details and arrange the required eligibility certification.
Send the form through the official route or ask SALB for help completing it.
Discuss the available formats and access arrangements with the library.

sections.heading: Who the service is for
paragraphs: SALB serves people who are blind, have low vision or another print disability that affects their ability to use ordinary printed books. A family member or helper can assist with the application.
Membership is free, but eligibility must be confirmed. Use the enrolment form and the library’s own guidance to establish which professional or authority should certify your application.

sections.heading: Choose an accessible reading format
paragraphs: The library provides accessible collections and member services, including audio and Braille reading. Ask which delivery, online catalogue or supported reading options are available for your circumstances.
Do not buy equipment solely on the assumption that it will be supplied or reimbursed. Confirm any device, postage or internet arrangements directly with SALB.

faq.question: Is this open to every library reader?
faq.answer: It is a specialist service for people with qualifying print disabilities. SALB assesses the required membership documentation.

faq.question: Does free membership mean free equipment?
faq.answer: The listing confirms free membership and library resources. Equipment and connectivity arrangements should be confirmed with SALB.

Free membership does not remove loan-return rules or charges for lost items. Ask about the branch’s conditions and return or renew loans before they become overdue.

faq.question: Can I use a computer there?

title: ESSA free public employment services | FreeHub
description: Free individual registration, job-search and matching support, with a CV compiled from your profile. Register as an individual on the Department of Employment and Labour’s ESSA portal and supply the requested identity or work-authorisation details.
intro: Employment Services of South Africa, known as ESSA, is the Department of Employment and Labour’s free jobseeker service. You can register your skills, create a work-seeker profile and use it for vacancy matching and a downloadable CV.
accessNote: Register as an individual on the Department of Employment and Labour’s ESSA portal and supply the requested identity or work-authorisation details.
steps: Open the official ESSA portal and choose individual registration.
Enter your identification and contact details, following the portal’s instructions.
Add qualifications, skills and employment history to complete your profile.
Check suitable opportunities and save or download your CV.

sections.heading: Make your profile useful
paragraphs: A complete profile gives employment practitioners the information needed to consider you for relevant opportunities. Add accurate qualifications, work experience and contact details, and update them when they change.
The department’s guide describes automatic CV compilation from the information you supply. Review the finished CV carefully before using it in an application.

sections.heading: Use the official free route
paragraphs: ESSA is a public employment service and individual registration is free. You still need access to a device and data, or assistance through a labour centre where available.
Registering is a step in a job search. Employers and programmes retain their own selection criteria, so a profile is not an offer of employment.

faq.question: Do I have to pay to register?
faq.answer: No. Individual ESSA registration is a free public employment service.

faq.question: Does registration guarantee a job?
faq.answer: No. Matching and applications depend on vacancies, your profile and the employer’s selection process.

sections.heading: Use the resources available now
paragraphs: Official revision and study material remains useful outside scheduled teaching sessions. Choose resources that match your subjects and the examination you intend to write.

The programme’s classroom or organised teaching periods are dated. The August–October 2026 period has ended, so this guide covers available learning resources rather than a currently open class intake.

sections.heading: Examination registration is a separate step
paragraphs: Downloading a guide does not register you for the National Senior Certificate or Senior Certificate examination. Confirm which route you qualify for and meet the official registration deadline.
The material is free. Your data, device, printing and any travel costs remain your responsibility.

faq.question: Does downloading the material register me for matric?
faq.answer: No. Examination eligibility and registration are handled separately by the education authorities.

faq.question: Are the 2026 August–October classes still running?
faq.answer: That advertised teaching period has ended. Use the resources and check the provider for any newly announced classes.

title: YES × Microsoft AI learning and conditional exam vouchers | FreeHub
description: Free AI learning with a conditional route to one funded certification examination voucher, subject to the programme’s requirements and allocation. Use the official programme, have a South African ID and Microsoft Learn profile, complete the specified modules, score at least 70% on the practice assessment and submit the required survey and evidence.
intro: The YES × Microsoft AI programme offers free learning and a conditional route to a certification examination voucher. Complete the stated learning, assessment and claim steps before expecting a voucher; allocation is subject to the programme’s rules.
accessNote: Use the official programme, have a South African ID and Microsoft Learn profile, complete the specified modules, score at least 70% on the practice assessment and submit the required survey and evidence.
steps: Open the official YES AI Skills site and follow its registration and learning route.
Use your Microsoft Learn profile to finish the required modules.
Complete the practice assessment with a score of at least 70% and retain the requested evidence.
Finish the compulsory survey and submit the certificate/voucher claim form with the required details.

sections.heading: Learning and the voucher are separate steps
paragraphs: The programme’s learning is free. To request the funded examination route, follow its specified modules, assessment, survey and evidence requirements, including a South African ID.
The programme advertises an allocation of 50,000 vouchers. That is the announced programme allocation, not confirmation that a particular number remains or that every claim will succeed.

sections.heading: Check the claim route before committing time
paragraphs: Use the current claim page to confirm the eligible learning path and the evidence required. The programme provides one qualifying examination voucher under its conditions.
The older Takealot draw shown in some campaign material closed on 31 October 2026. This guide covers learning and the conditional examination benefit, with no current cash or shopping-prize claim.

faq.question: Will I definitely receive an exam voucher?
faq.answer: No. You must meet the programme’s requirements and submit a qualifying claim; availability is subject to the allocation and provider processing.

faq.question: Is the Takealot giveaway still open?
faq.answer: No. That separate draw closed on 31 October 2026 and is not included as a current offer.
